title: Reverse String
summary: Reverse the positions of the characters in s by changing the existing array.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100000 elements. Every element is one printable ASCII character. Serialize the mutated character array. R returns the updated character vector.
contractDetails.output-checking: Call reverseString(s), then serialize the same mutable character array. R returns the updated vector. Elements are one-character strings in the language-independent fixture.

statement: Reverse the positions of the characters in s by changing the existing array. Return no value in languages with mutable arrays. Use constant extra storage.

examples.explanation: The endpoints exchange positions, followed by the middle pair.
A single character stays in place.
The space is a character and the array is already symmetric.

constraints: 1–100000 elements. Every element is one printable ASCII character. Serialize the mutated character array. R returns the updated character vector.
hints: Conceptual: The first and last positions must exchange places.
Directional: Work inward from both ends.
Implementation: Swap the endpoint characters and move each endpoint one position toward the center.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space for mutable arrays.
